title: SIDE STORY: MANSFIELD BREAK RERUN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: MANSFIELD BREAK RERUN
EVENT DURATION: May 26, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – June 9, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Mansfield Break event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from event shop.
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
[Escape Plan] Duration: May 26, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – June 5, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Mansfield Daily Life] Duration: May 26, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – June 5, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[BE PREPARED]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Be Prepared] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Robin, Mansfield Prison Cell Furniture (Pieces), Factory Steels.
[SECRET CHANNEL]
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Factory Steels by clearing event stages and Be Prepared missions. Factory Steels can be used to redeem items from Secret Channel.
MAIN REWARDS: Robin's Token, Mansfield Prison Cell Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Battle Record, Elite Materials, etc.
NOTE:
The requirements to obtain certain medals of this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the
adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once log in.
Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.
The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to
[Intelligence Certificate Exchange Info] for more details.
[Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
Operators Mountain, Robin, Kafka, and Pinecone will gain more trust during the event rerun.
After the event rerun ends, this event will be archived into [Side Story] and become permanently available.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING RERUN – JAIL TIGER UNCHAINED
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Jail Tiger Unchained", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Mountain
★★★★★: Kafka / Silence
★★★★: Pinecone
03 EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVAL AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection – Gift of Wild for Robin
04 TEST COLLECTION & ICEFIELD MESSENGER RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Test Collection – The Law for Saria
Icefield Messenger Collection – Candy Cape for Weedy
Icefield Messenger Collection - Snowy Echo for Elysium
Icefield Messenger Collection – Snowywatch for Firewatch
05 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – MANSFIELD PRISON CELL
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
Mansfield Break event rewards and redeem in Secret Channel (Pieces)
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
The furniture pieces of this furniture set will be available at the Store from June 22, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – July 6, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
06 RECORD RESTORATION: CODE OF BRAWL
UPDATE TIME: May 26, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The Record Restoration of Code of Brawl will be open after the next update. The limited event rewards will be permanently available for players to unlock.
